thread:
erin: Heads-up: runtime vuln in runc upstream (CVE-2026-9999) showed up in our runtime dependency scan. Affected images that embed runc or use older containerd may be exploitable. We should coordinate a base rebuild + runtime policy lockdown.
dan: yikes. Is this hitting prod right now? any incidents?
erin: Not detected in prod yet — scanner found usages in a subset of staging images and some internal test infra. I want to push a hardened seccomp + eBPF probe before rolling new images.
priya: Agree. Two tracks: 1) rebuild base with patched runc and cosign-attest the artifact, 2) tighten kubelet/pod RBAC and seccomp defaults so new pods get stricter profiles.
oah: For (1) we need signing keys and an audit trail. Can we use the KMS attestation key we created last quarter, or do we create a dedicated ephemeral signing key for this rebuild?
erin: Prefer ephemeral subkey 'attest-rebuild-4291' so we can revoke quickly if anything smells off. Also want in-toto attestation pointing to the build system / pipeline.
priya: I'll draft the RBAC change: add a rolebinding image-rebuiler-temp to group ci-runners with permission to push to staging-registry and to call kms.asymmetricSign on the subkey. Time-bounded for 2 hours.
oah: Also need kube audit rules to surface any exec/attach attempts to pods using the old runtime. Add a policy filter:
```
"requestURI": "/api/v1/namespaces/*/pods/exec"
"user.username": "system:serviceaccount:*:ci-rebuilder"
```
and forward to security sink.
derp-bot: [BUILD] base-rebuild-#709 started by erin -> running tests and seccomp validation.
erin: Seccomp change (diff):
```diff
- allow: {"name": "clone", "action": "SCMP_ACT_ALLOW"}
+ allow: {"name": "clone", "action": "SCMP_ACT_ERRNO"}
```
This blocks certain clone+unshare paths that runc exploit uses. We'll run e2e.
dan: Good. One operational ask: CI needs the temporary KMS binding. Priya, can you post the minimal IAM JSON we need? Keep only AsymmetricSign and nothing else.
priya: Draft IAM binding: principals: serviceAccount:ci-rebuilder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier (custom) with method AsymmetricSign only, condition: request.time < timestamp("2026-04-11T15:30:00Z"). Posting in a sec channel DM.
oah: For tracing, add image labels: "attested-by=ci-rebuilder", "attest-id=${BUILD_ID}", and push SBOM to artifact registry. We'll need the attestation envelope id in audit logs to link sign event -> image digest.
erin: Build-bot: please emit the cosign attestation step id when done.
build-bot: [BUILD] cosign: created attestation envelope id: attest:sha256:aa11bb22cc33 (signed with kms:attest-rebuild-4291)
erin: Received. I'll schedule a canary deploy to staging with the attested image and run incident-sim tests (container escape attempts).
dan: After canary passes, let's coordinate a short maintenance window for prod rollout and add a gating policy in the console to only allow images with attestation from the approved key.
priya: I'll open the RBAC change PR and include the temporary binding + revoke script. Also updating runbook: revoke-steps, audit lookup query for KMS sign events and kube exec events.
oah: Example log filter (KMS sign):
```
resource.type="kms_key"
protoPayload.methodName:"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign"
protoPayload.request.name:"projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild-kr/cryptoKeys/attest-rebuild-4291"
```
noah: And kube audit filter for exec/attach: protoPayload.methodName:"kubectl.exec" ??? (checking exact field) but we'll match requestURI contains "/exec".
erin: Thanks all. Plan: priya creates binding, noah wires alert sinks, build-bot completes sign + posts attest id, I run canary. If anything odd, we revoke subkey and blacklist image digest.
dan: thumbs-up. Keep this thread for sign-off and post the final attest id + canary result.
erin: Will do. Closing for now until rebuild finishes. :lock:
